content: File-size ratchet (500 lines) binds hard: bridge.ts sat at 498/500, so new wiring had to be paid for by moving the per-delta noise classifier out to src/runs/stream/delta-noise.ts and the monitor wiring into turn-monitor.ts via a bridgeTurnMonitor() helper taking an onTerminalCancelled callback. Biome's formatter re-flows signatures and can push a hand-counted file back over the threshold — recount after every biome --write pass.
